t: The LAP Solidaster LED ceiling light is a modern, low-profile flush light fitting designed to provide bright, reliable illumination. This black mains-powered 29cm ceiling light is ideal for trade professionals and DIYers installing fixtures in bathrooms, kitchens and utility rooms. Featuring an IP44 rating, the unit is suitable for bathroom zones 2 and 3. The integrated LED technology delivers a powerful 1600 lumen output with a selectable colour temperature, allowing users to switch between warm white and cool white tones. A durable plastic body and diffuser ensure even light distribution and a long-lasting performance of up to 25,000 hours.
b: Fixings Supplied for Quick & Easy Installation
